name: Multi-signal — 2 real + 1 noise
description: Three news topics in one dataset. topic_A has a real -0.30 correlation with market_return at lag 7; topic_B has +0.20 at lag 30; topic_C has no link. A correct method ranks A and B above C, and confirms only A and B.

data_generating_process.market_return: sum_i r_i * z(topic_i[t - lag_i]) + sqrt(1 - sum r_i^2) * z(eps), scaled by 0.01

noise_signals.comment: No causal link — should not be confirmed at any lag

expected_method_behavior.comment: Tests multi-hypothesis discipline. With BH FDR at q<0.1, an unbiased pipeline rejects topic_C while keeping A and B.
